Greetings, Agents!

 

Celebrate the third anniversary of Marvel Future Fight! We are applying exciting new updates that will delight you.

 

Ten uniforms inspired by Marvel’s Avengers: Infinity War will be added to the game, including the Mad Titan, Thanos himself. You will also see new uniforms for Captain America and Iron Man, along with others.

 

A new Tier will be added to further enhance Captain America. He will now be able to break through his limitation and become Tier-3, which includes new growth factors to further enhance his abilities.

 

The World Boss stage will be back, armed with a significant change including Raid Levels, new rewards, and expanded levels of difficulty to provide greater challenges for your newfound strength. Test your power and skills against the very best World Bosses the game has to offer.

 

A new Legendary Battle inspired by Marvel’s Avengers: Infinity War will also be added. This will allow you to relive the epic showdown between the Mad Titan and the heroes.

 

Other changes also include lobby UI and others. Hurry now and see details below.

▣ 10 New Uniforms Added

 

New uniforms for Captain America, Iron Man, Black Widow, Thor, Spider-Man, Groot, Winter Soldier, Proxima Midnight, Corvus Glaive, and Thanos have been added.


* The 10 new uniforms will be on a 40% SALE for a limited period. Check out the new uniforms at the Marvel Universe/Uniform Room in the Shop.

* New Uniforms will be available at the following price:


 

 

▣Revamp of World Boss Content

 

The World Boss content has undergone a significant revamp, with an all-new design and challenges. Challenge yourself and increase your Raid Level, acquire new rewards, and face a wide range of difficulty! 

 

(Added at 10:10 UTC+0)

※ World Boss entries and used character list will be reset after the update
※ Current World Boss Ultimate first clear reward will be renewed with another reward after the update

1. World Boss / World Boss Ultimate content integrated

The existing World Boss (including Beginner mode) and World Boss Ultimate content have been integrated and now accessible on a single screen.


- All 10 stages now available in one screen.
※ Thanos Stage has been replaced with Thanos (Infinity).


- There are now three levels of difficulty: Beginner, Normal, and Ultimate.
※ Beginner, Normal, and Ultimate Stages share the number of entries.

In addition to the integration of World Boss difficulty, you can see the newly-modified Proxima Midnight in Ultimate difficulty.

※ Currently Ultimate difficulty is only available against Proxima Midnight. Other bosses will be available through future updates.


- Proxima Midnight appears in her uniform inspired by Marvel’s Avengers: Infinity War! Check her out in Ultimate World Boss difficulty.

2. Raid Level and Character Bonus

Character Bonus is a new stat in replacement of the previous World Boss Bonuses.

Increase your character’s Raid Level to earn additional Character Bonus that can be used in World Boss content.


- Raid Levels and Character Bonus effects can be found in the World Boss Challenge Info.

Details regarding the revamped World Boss stage:

- Raid Levels and Character Bonus effects apply only in World Boss modes.
- Character Bonus can be increased based on the number of Tier-2 Characters owned.
- Previous World Boss Bonuses have been replaced with new Character Bonus.

[Valor?]

A brand-new stat called ‘Valor’ has been added. It is only available in World Boss missions and can be raised by increasing the Raid level and/or by Character Bonus. The closer the stat is to the recommended level for each stage, the stronger your stage boosts become. (Decreasing Boss’s attack rate, increasing your own attack rate)


- Recommended valor can be found on the world boss info and difficulty selection screen


3. New Advancement Materials Added to the World Boss Ultimate Rewards
Obtain new materials used for character Potential level advancements and Tier-3 advancements through World Boss Ultimate.

Dimension Dust, Titan Component Pack, Cosmic Cube Fragment, and Titan’s Records have been added as rewards.

 

4. More Stages in Ultimate Mode

Previously featuring five levels of difficulty, the World Boss Ultimate will now expand significantly to include many more levels.

You will be able to obtain newly-added World Boss materials more quickly through the first-clear rewards from each stage.

 

 

▣New Growth Factor - Potential and Tier-3 Advancement Added

 

The Potential system and Tier-3 advancement have been added to further expand the character's growth.

 

 

A step-by-step guide on the new growth factor!

 

Step 1: Clear World Boss: Ultimate

-      Gain essential rewards for Tier-3 advancement

 

Step 2: Realize Potential after clearing World Boss

-      Clear World Bosses to fill up the gauge required to unlock Potential

 

Step 3: Work Up to 100% Chance of Raising Level of Potential

-      This increases the character level cap, and therefore raising the level cap of Gear as well

 

Step 4: Achieve Level 70 + Gear Level at 25

-      This enables advancement to Tier-3

 

Step 5: Advance to Tier-3!!

-      Be prepared to unleash the all-powerful new active skill

 

Step 6: Challenge World Boss: Ultimate at a Higher Level

-      Use your newfound power to clear each stage and gain new first-clear rewards to boost your characters

 

 

Potential Power

Potential allows characters at Tier-2 to advance the character level and gear level further.

You must realize your Potential in order to advance towards ultimately reaching Tier-3.

※Realizing Potential and enhancing its level will be available for 11 characters: Captain America, Iron Man, Black Widow, Thor, Spider-Man, Groot, Winter Soldier, Doctor Strange, Proxima Midnight, Corvus Glaive and Thanos.

※The list of characters with Potential enhancements can be checked through the Marvel Universe Menu.

- Potential points are required to unlock the Potential of a character. These points can be earned by clearing the World Boss on Normal or higher difficulty modes using the character.

 

Potential Enhancement

A character’s Potential level can be further upgraded after realizing the character’s Potential.

Potential can be increased up to Level 6.

The success rate for upgrading Potential levels can be increased by using materials obtained from World Bosses. These include Black Anti-Matter and Norn Stones of Chaos.

The more materials you invest, the higher success rate you can acquire. You can reach 100% success rate with the materials you select from the options given.


- Each material has a different success rate, so invest on these materials and reach full Potential.

- You can also reach 100% success rate by investing 1 type of material and not all 3 types.
- Some characters such as Thanos may require a different amount of materials for different success rates as opposed to other characters.

- Successful Potential upgrade increases the character's maximum level.

 


- Even if you fail to upgrade your Potential level, you will get to keep half of your previous success rate.



Advancing Levels from 60 to 70 with Potential

Characters that complete Potential upgrades can advance to level 70.

As with World Boss characters, experience points can be acquired through the character's Biometrics or X-Genes.


- After Level 60, Biometrics or X-Genes are required to raise the character level.

Enhancing characters’ gear now require new materials called Essence of Dimension and Titan Component Pack. These items can be obtained through World Boss Ultimate.


- New Gear-reinforcement materials can be obtained from World Boss Ultimate.
※The amount of Gear Upgrade materials required may differ based on character’s type. (ex. Native Tier-2 characters will require more materials)

 

Tier-3 Advancement

After achieving Potential Level 6, with both character and gear levels at maximum levels, be prepared to finally advance to Tier-3. You will experience a massive enhancement to the character, armed with a powerful new skill.

- With this update, Captain America's Tier-3 advancement is available.


- Advancing to Tier-3 will require four types of materials that are only available through World Boss Ultimate.

 

Upgrading to Tier-3 will significantly increase your character’s abilities and grant a powerful, never-before-seen new active skill.

- New Powerful Active Skill added to Tier-3 can only be used if the gauge reaches 100%, but the sheer devastation of the skill will make it worth the effort.

 

▣ New Legendary Battle Story Added!

 

Relive the story of the heroes battling the Mad Titan, Thanos, through the new Legendary Battle – Marvel’s Avengers: Infinity War.

- There are two difficulty levels available on this Legendary Battle: Normal and Extreme. Beware, the Extreme mode is named Extreme for a reason.

 

 

The Extreme Mode can be accessed by purchasing the Marvel’s Avengers: Infinity War – Extreme Package for 2,500 Crystals. Beware: Extreme mode is not for the faint-hearted. Be prepared.

 

▣New Limited Items

New package that provides Tony Stark’s Supply Chest for 7-days has been added to the Featured Shop.

 

What is [Tony Stark's Supply]?

By opening the chest, acquire one of the following items randomly: Gold, Clear Tickets, Energy, 5★ and 6★ Rank Up Ticket, 5★ and 6★ Mastery Ticket, 6★ Mega Rank Up Ticket, and 6★ Mega Mastery Ticket.

※ Reward rates will be released at a later date.

 

▣Lobby UI Changes

The existing lobby UI changes are as follows:

1. Store, Team Management, Dimensions Rift, Content Board, and Battle positions can be accessed from the Lobby screen.




[Expanded menu displayed when ① is tapped]

- Inbox and Friends can be viewed on the menu.

2. Main menu is now accessible even in mission selection screen through a hidden side window.


 

▣Other Changes

1. Uru slots can now be unlocked based on the Gear Enhancement Level for the character instead of S.H.I.E.L.D. level.


Gear Enhancement level +8: Unlocks 2 Uru slots

Gear Enhancement level +12: Unlocks 1 Uru slot

Gear Enhancement level +16: Unlocks 1 Uru slot

Gear Enhancement level +20: Unlocks 1 Uru slot

- Uru Amplification is available starting with Gear Enhancement level +20 as before!

 

2. Uru Amplification is now available without having to equip enchanted Urus on Uru slots.

3. Added a confirmation window when purchasing items form the Acquire Character shop.

4. Result screen in Alliance Conquest will now have a Retry button instead of a Home Button.

5. The 1+2 Gold event is now a permanent addition to the Shop, and the event tag will be removed as a result.

 

 

Excited for the new updates? Enjoy… but it doesn’t seem like this is over. Stay tuned…
